questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.q: Among the following, the correct statement is
options: $pH$ decreases when solid ammonium chloride is added to a dilute aqueous solution of $N{H}_{3}$
$pH$& decreases when solid sodium acetate is added to a dilute aqueous solution of acetic acid
$pH$ decreases when solid $NaCl$ is added to a dilute aqueous solution of $NaOH$
$pH$ decreases when solid sodium oxalate is added to a dilute aqueous solution of oxalic acid
questions.solution:
& Dil.aqueous solution of $N{H}_{3}$ is $N{H}_{4}OH$

$N{H}_{4}OH ⇌ N{H}_{4}^{+} + OH^{-}$

On adding solid ammonium chloride

$N{H}_{4}Cl ⟶ N{H}_{4}^{+} + Cl^{-}$

The reaction moves backward due to common ion effect. The concentration of $OH^{-}$ decreases and hence the $pH$ decreases.

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.q: A buffer solution can be prepared by mixing equal volumes of
questions.solution:
The solutions which resist change in $pH$ on dilution or with the addition of small amounts of acid or alkali are called buffer solution. It is a mixture of weak base with its salt or weak acid with its salt.

Thus, buffer solution can be prepared by mixing equal volumes of $0. 2M{NH}_{4}OH$ (weak base) and $0. 1MHCl$ (strong acid). It results in the formation of ${NH}_{4}OH$ (weak base) $+ {NH}_{4}Cl$ (salt of weak base ${NH}_{4}OH$ ), which is a basic buffer mixture.
